title: Qandil Seafood
service: Menu design, mockups, Instagram launch assets
blurb: A seafood menu that has to be read in bad light, with wet hands, at a table full of people. Big type, generous air, and one illustration mark that ties print and Instagram together.
alt: Qandil Seafood restaurant menu design with illustrated logo mark and dish photography
details: Menu architecture: categories first, prices second — visitors scan, they do not read.
Print-ready file with bleed and CMYK-safe imagery; same visual language reused for the Instagram page.
Hand-drawn mark used as a stamp across packaging and social.
